Home Renovation Checklist

A step-by-step checklist to plan a renovation without nasty surprises.

Home / Guides / Home Renovation Checklist

By the Manzil Homes design team · Visakhapatnam

Renovating an older home can give you a modern space without moving, but surprises hide behind walls. This checklist helps you plan properly.

Before you design

  • Get a structural check before moving or removing any walls
  • Inspect for seepage, dampness and leaks
  • Check the age and condition of electrical wiring
  • Check plumbing lines and water pressure
  • Confirm society or building rules if you live in an apartment

Plan the scope

  • List rooms to renovate and must-haves for each
  • Decide whether to renovate in phases or all at once
  • Plan where you will live during the work

Fix the basics first

Waterproofing, rewiring and plumbing come before any finishes. New interiors on top of old problems won't last.

Then design

Re-plan the layout for light, flow and Vastu, then design the kitchen, bathrooms, storage, flooring, ceilings and lighting.

During the work

  • Protect furniture and floors you are keeping
  • Agree on working hours with neighbours
  • Keep track of changes against the BOQ

At handover

  • Test every light, switch, tap and drain
  • Check all shutters, drawers and locks
  • Collect warranties and manuals

Because Manzil Homes is led by a structural engineer, we always start renovations with a structural and services check, so the new design fixes problems instead of hiding them.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I live in my home during renovation?

Often yes, with phased work and protection. It depends on the scope.

What should be done first in a renovation?

Structural checks, waterproofing, electrical and plumbing, before any finishes.

Do you renovate apartments?

Yes, both apartments and independent houses.
